lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4 to 5 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral flank, arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, with circular blobs positioned at the intersection points of these bands and horizontal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, showing a sharp transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch-like indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated, dark-pixel clusters (commensal fish) visible near the ventral surface of the pectoral fin and lower lateral flank.
